items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He told me he's from across the river and he knew a guy named Emmett Hardy over there. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He knew Emmett when he was trying to learn how to make a note on the horn.

ctx.x: He told me he's from across the river and he knew a guy named Emmett Hardy over there. Emmett Hardy, sure. Did you know Emmett? Oh yeah.
He knew Emmett when he was trying to learn how to make a note on the horn.
Oh. Was he good? He developed pretty good.
